messages:
nina: quick one — customer hit a 413 on an embeddings call. payload ~2.2MB mixed dims, client preflight returned estimated_units=1200 but runtime splitter ended up charging ~2400. behavior is surprising to them :thinking:

sam: ugh. is the preflight using optimistic assumptions (no split) while runtime does conservative split?

nina: looks like preflight estimates bytes->units with a naive per-item dim guess; when splitter runs it sees a worst-case quantization path and doubles units. we should decide what the header means — optimistic vs conservative.

marco: from console POV we need a single number to show users. proposal: server exposes two headers: `X-Redwood-Embed-Estimate: optimistic=1200;conservative=2400` and `X-Redwood-Embed-Plan: split=2;parts=[0..1023,1024..2047]` so UI can show "Estimated units (low/hi)" and a suggested split.

trina: love exposing both. question: do we want auto-split on behalf of SDKs or prefer fast-fail + suggested plan? mobile SDKs hate opaque retries.

sam: SDKs should get an advisory flow. default to `auto_split=false` but provide an `auto_split=true` opt-in. API header could be `X-Redwood-Embed-Advice: auto_split_supported=true;recommended_split=2`. then SDKs can decide.

nina: implementation note: computing conservative estimate is cheap (use quantized size heuristic). generating a split plan is also cheap. the hard part: making preflight compute the same heuristic so numbers match. either make preflight conservative (safer) or add both fields.

marco: console mock: show compact row: [units low] / [units high] — if split plan exists show "suggested split" with a toggle to apply to request history (one-click resubmit). also surface a link to a telemetry trace for estimate mismatch.

trina: product preference: show both, default preflight to conservative for billing predictability, but keep optimistic available as "best case" in details. that reduces customer support noise.

sam: telemetry wise we should add `embed.estimate_error_ratio` (count where actual_units > preflight_conservative by >10%). alert if >1% across tenants.

nina: agree. also add a sample event `embed.estimate_diff` with tags: tenant_id, model, dims, preflight_est, runtime_units. small payloads only.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rolling canary: patch `embed-preflight` service -> 10% of traffic starting 2026-03-21T15:00Z.

marco: ok I'll mock UI strings and a tiny console CTA. sam/nina — can we get a spec (headers + telemetry + SDK flags) by EOD?

sam: will draft header names + SDK flow now, ping when done.

nina: i'll write the conservative heuristic pseudo-code and run it against last week's traces to get baseline numbers.

trina: thanks all. goal: fewer surprised invoices and cleaner support UX. :thumbsup:
